info.title: BodhAI API
info.description: Adaptive learning platform backend for Classes 6-10 in India

get.description: Returns 200 OK if the FastAPI process is active and accepting requests.
Probes PostgreSQL and Redis connections to verify operational readiness.

200.description: All backend dependencies are healthy and ready to serve traffic.

503.description: One or more dependencies (PostgreSQL or Redis) are unavailable.

post.description: Clear access, refresh, and CSRF cookies.
